sources.entry: Geniea - Generated prompts for personal journeys. #free

summary.name: Geniea
summary.one_liner: Geniea is a free AI prompt improver that turns a rough idea into a detailed prompt for Midjourney, ChatGPT Image, music and video models.
use_cases: Expanding a rough idea into a detailed image prompt
Writing prompts for Midjourney or ChatGPT image generation
Finding and reusing Midjourney style reference codes
Drafting prompts for AI music in Suno
Checking AI-generated product images against the real product
summary.what_it_does: Geniea takes a short idea or brief and rewrites it as a more detailed prompt with material, light and composition details, which the user then copies into the AI model of their choice. It offers prompt formats tailored to different models, including Midjourney, ChatGPT Image, music and video. A style collection lists Midjourney style reference (--sref) codes that users can copy and try with their own subject. It also includes a free checklist for sellers to compare AI-generated product images against their own product photo (logo, color, shape, label text, part count); the checklist is completed manually and images stay in the browser. Geniea does not generate the images, songs or videos itself.
notable: Product image checklist for comparing AI images with real products, with images kept in the browser
Prompt formats tailored to each model type (image, music, video)
caveats: Limited to 3 free prompt rewrites per IP address per day, resetting at 00:00 UTC
Does not create the image, song or video itself; prompts must be pasted into another model
